purpose: Required operating and boundary verification map; not an execution report.

required_assertions: Eligible original preference reaches first ordinary provider request without mutation.
Uncompiled evidence retains event, actor and source metadata.
An active index with no match is empty.
Disabled access or an incomplete index is unavailable, not absence.
Malformed *** search is failed.
Closed independent SQLite read connection reports failed without source text or database details.
Durable turn storage remains live.
Successful accepted evidence survives a failed conversation generator and a later empty search.
Each tool outcome remains distinct in actual provider replay.
Live compact activity is success/partial/partial; persisted history retains completed request association.
Exact request hashes, bytes, source refs and cumulative serialized memory-message accounting match.
Stalled local embedding query respects the deadline.
Already eligible lexical support remains available and failure cannot become exhaustive empty.
Active dense support remains usable during independent lexical rebuild.
When dense also becomes unavailable, the result is unavailable, not empty.
Accepted searches, conversation searches and expansion share the same finite budget.
A refused post-budget attempt does not reset or authorize more Kernel work.
rows.limitation: Existing tests assert exhausted behavior. The integrated measurement must additionally count actual Kernel calls separately from SearchAttempts, which includes refusals.

required_assertions: Repeated synthetic evidence and tool-result replay are charged on every actual request.
Supported findings and an explicit exhausted warning reach the reader before bounded termination.
A provider that continues after exhaustion cannot dispatch beyond 36864 cumulative memory bytes; unadmitted requests create no extra receipt.
Cancellation returns context.Canceled; lease loss terminates the stale turn.
No late provider dispatch, approval, mutation or extra evidence receipt occurs.
The replacement owner lease survives stale cleanup; original receipt remains immutable.
rows.expected_terminal: interrupted or rejected continuation; no fabricated final cancelled provider dispatch
rows.limitation: A cancelled turn must not send another provider request merely to expose a cancelled label; UI labels are checked separately.

required_assertions: Forged, same-area-but-never-retrieved and other-area anchors cannot authorize expansion.
The existing eligible anchor remains available without exposing forbidden source.
before/after greater than two is a failed individual expansion.
Previously supplied evidence survives with partial aggregate status.
Mixed repeated expansion calls exhaust the shared budget.
Duplicate expansion and overlapping ranges do not multiply source bytes.
Exact UTF-8 locators reconstruct authorized original text.
Retired ranges are subtracted while independent eligible text survives.
Omitted secret neighbor, omitted retired interval and bounded durable-event gap each report truncated:true.
Gap case reports matches:0 without claiming a complete window.
Eligible unrelated text is preserved.
Earlier messages in the selected session may be retrieved.
The live current user root and later/current-session positions cannot become earlier evidence.
Dense discovery obeys the same cutoff.
After opt-out, original supplemental text, source/session IDs and opaque canary are absent from complete RequestBytes.
Cover both Chat Completions messages and native Responses input/opaque items.
Original durable assistant tool-call arguments remain intact locally.
Global accepted memory does not authorize raw Global conversation from a project/workspace.
Other projects/workspaces and sibling session-only memories stay excluded.
Promoted source evidence retains its original source boundary.
Dense/graph candidate discovery cannot widen current source authorization.
Secret-bearing accepted or neighboring source text is withheld.
Retrieval and expansion do not promote a secret-bearing hit into eligible evidence.
Historical valid time is half-open and separate from exact knowledge pins.
Unknown validity stays unknown.
Expansion inherits the original anchor intent/knowledge pin.
Current lifecycle metadata never silently repins historical evidence.
Current retirement withdraws evidence before continuation while preserving original receipt.
Explicit historical read can inspect marked retired evidence, but cannot restore revoked source access.
Dense stale hits recheck retired UTF-8 ranges and source retraction.
Approved correction refreshes the current query before the next provider dispatch.
A full held-evidence set can admit a useful follow-up within bounds.
Refreshing lost evidence must not undo another explicit temporal view.
New accepted conflict, restored conflict and newer owner statement refresh an unpinned current investigation.
Explicit knowledge pins remain unchanged and do not acquire later facts.
Original request receipts are not rewritten.
Accepted exact alias evidence includes only currently eligible identity mapping.
Alias retirement or original alias source restriction cannot be bypassed by query refresh.
Independently eligible Claim evidence remains inspectable without a revoked alias.
Unchanged continuations reuse exact immutable references without redoing searches.
Search/refresh/reuse counters and serialized replay bytes are measured accurately.
A graph conclusion carries its ordered accepted support Claims.
Revoked bridge or mismatched temporal view cannot remain a valid path.
Budget trimming removes orphaned path/conflict metadata.
A newer owner episode remains an attributed possible discrepancy, not an approved correction.
Each context snapshot is committed before the actual provider request and matches exact RequestBytes hash/size and evidence refs.
Completed/interrupted event order survives reopening SQLite.
HTTP keeps prepared, completed and interrupted request states distinct; no answer ID is fabricated for an interrupted request.
Changed source hash, locator, event, authority or observation timestamp returns unavailable inspection without text.
The genuine original reference remains available and unmodified.
Original answer-associated source positions and Claim versions survive restart/correction/retirement.
Source restriction withholds current text without rewriting original references.
Conflict/newer relation inspection is reconstructed only from currently available selected support.
A different selected conversation is rejected.
Replacement generation is building and cannot serve unreconciled paraphrase hits.
Restart resumes bounded backfill and recovers original source under the new generation.
In-flight embedding cannot revive retired evidence or skip a concurrent accepted append.
Disabled-period changes reconcile before re-enable.
Obsolete lexical statistics and generation metadata cannot become authoritative evidence.
An obsolete active dense configuration does not trigger query embedding or return old-generation evidence.
Bounded reconciliation restores the exact retained original source.
Wrong/absent/malformed manifest sends zero input-bearing requests.
Model replacement during inference is rejected.
Malformed/wrong-dimension/nonfinite/oversized vectors return no partial vector batch.
Wrong model name and manifest digest both preserve exactly eligible lexical support with partial tool/projection/receipt status.
After metadata rejection, no input-bearing embedding request or body bytes are sent; actual request SHA256/size and immutable source receipt agree.
Only literal loopback HTTP or Unix socket endpoints are accepted.
Redirect destinations and configured proxies receive no input.
Opt-out before/during manifest verification sends no embedding input.
Cancellation and response-body deadline preserve their cause without a vector or late dispatch.
rows.platform_note: The Unix socket test explicitly skips Windows; the declared current macOS environment should execute it.

required_assertions: Automatic recall can retain its original capability grant while model read schemas and dispatch are disabled.
Actual composed request bytes and saved snapshot agree; no post-composition stripping.
Default behavior and legacy per-turn resolution remain enabled.
Each state has its distinct compact label.
Partial and exhausted retain supplied evidence count and are not called No matches.

required_assertions: Supplemental memory fits the configured complete request allowance without evicting original discussion.
A large finding that cannot fit does not discard a smaller eligible original.
Whole original sources, exact request receipts and cumulative delivery accounting remain valid.

gaps.detail: Exhaustion tests check outcomes and finite bytes; SearchAttempts includes refused post-budget attempts. The integrated runner must count actual delegated Kernel searches independently to compare with the adopted max8 gate.

This map cannot establish the newly adopted 24-case, six-condition model quality, latency, serialized cost, per-case index/RSS or semantic rubric results. Run the frozen harness and record every outcome; prior component passes are development evidence only.

Existing full-turn cancel/lease tests assert no late effects, and adapter tests have bounded completion waits. The integrated operating report still must record actual cancellation/deadline tail measurements; do not invent a duration from the timeout constant.

verification_instructions: Resolve every mapped test against the frozen exported tree; source names were statically verified when this manifest was authored.
Run exact listed commands or equivalent package-batched anchored names and preserve raw output. Exit0 without actually matched tests is not a pass.
Do not run timing/model experiments concurrently with these CPU-heavy checks.
Record assertions, observed statuses, elapsed time, failures and skips separately from this expectation manifest.
Run ./scripts/verify-change.sh before handoff; this mapping does not replace required repository verification.
